perception.matching_method: same-frame class + projected truth centre inside exact bbox, unique both ways; WM identities require consistent bbox-to-track associations
perception.matching_limitation: geometric correspondence does not independently prove occlusion visibility; partial boxes excluding the centre remain unmatched; no nearest-distance fallback
perception.coordinate_convention: initial robot right/forward metres; right=[cos(h0),-sin(h0)], forward=[-sin(h0),-cos(h0)]
perception.error_sample_definition: one sample per logged CONFIRMED red track per observation with unique identity and active exact-frame truth; repeated estimates count as repeated samples

first_logged_wm_presence.note: first logged WM presence, not first raw sighting
